[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Free the @@ global destination from the header line and teach it to[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]absorb[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A `@@route` / `@@route+block-id` global destination declaration can[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]be typed on any line of any capture item instead of only on a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]header line, and typing a bare `@@` inside an item that already [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]carries a `@file` reference moves that reference onto the `@@` and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]deletes the original, so a draft can never end up with a shadowed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]local marker or two competing declarations.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Position-free @@ declarations in the capture grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: make any `@@…` token a global destination declaration anywhere [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in a draft, drop the header-line-only restriction, add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate-declaration and shadowed-local diagnostics, and update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture, capture-parse, capture-complete, help text, docs, and tests.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob capture-rewrite and the bare @@ absorption rule[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rewrite[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rewrite: add the `bob capture-rewrite` subcommand that turns a bare `@@`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into `@@<payload>` by absorbing the item's local destination marker (or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the draft's other declaration), deleting the source token and returning [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]edits, cursor, and a human summary.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac capture panel absorbs @@ as you type[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
